newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Seagate estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Seagate estimates raised.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said its analyst Patrick Tenney raised earnings estimates for Seagate Technology Inc to $3.56 a share from $3.17 for 1997 and to $4.68 from $4.09 for 1998.
-- The higher estimates are based on Seagate's quarterly earnings report late Tuesday that was ahead of expectations, Tenney said in a statement.
-- "In our opinion Seagate remains the strongest positioned public disk drive company with significant synergies in its vertical integration and cost structure," Tenney said.
